title: Ladders: the rules everyone forgets
lines: A ladder looks simple, until you fall off it.
Face the ladder and keep three points of contact at all times.
One person per rung, and no more than one hundred fifty kilos.
On a long ladder, don't climb to the very top.
Long or heavy work at height? A boom lift may be the answer.
Ofek At Tal Cranes. Safety first.
